answer: Registration sits behind a velvet rope: the applicant posts a stake before it can submit or review, and reviewers may slash that stake after a spot check. A verdict becomes final only when two reviewers independently re-run the claimed work. Dormant identities lose the stake when their review window closes, so a farm cannot forge a history and wander back later. A thousand fake identities cost a thousand live stakes and a thousand re-runs, more than honest work pays.
